node.html: A Redis clone implementation written in Go that replicates the core functionality of Redis in-memory data structure store. Features key-value storage, command processing, and compatibility with redis-cli for testing. Easy setup - just run the Go server and connect via standard Redis client tools.

Rate Limiter implementation with configurable request throttling using token bucket/sliding window algorithms. Prevents API abuse, DDoS attacks, ensures fair resource usage. Includes middleware integration, multiple storage backends, and customizable limits for web applications.
Command-line reminder application for managing tasks and notifications. Features task scheduling, persistent storage, and terminal-based interface for quick reminder management and productivity.
Lightweight HTTP server implementation in Go. Features basic routing, request handling, and static file serving. Simple, fast, and efficient server for development and learning purposes.
Real estate search application built with GRAND stack (GraphQL, React, Apollo, Neo4j). Features property search, filtering, and reviews dashboard with multiple client interfaces including mobile.

Node.js handles signaling via Socket.IO, React.js manages UI and video streams, WebRTC enables direct browser-to-browser connections. Server only facilitates initial handshake, then participants communicate directly. Reduces latency, cuts server costs, improves privacy.
Decentralized file storage application built on Ethereum blockchain. Provides secure, distributed storage solution using smart contracts and IPFS integration for tamper-proof file management.

Full-stack social media application built with MERN stack, GraphQL, and Apollo. Features post creation, commenting system, user authentication, and real-time interactions with modern web technologies.
The Smart Spoon is a self-stabilizing utensil designed to assist individuals with impaired motor skills, such as those suffering from Parkinson's Disease, in eating independently without assistance.
A simple reactjs website for a restaurant built with reactjs and Firebase.
